item.title: Frank Elsner Builds Big Ideas Through Steady Action
item.description: Big ideas often get credit for changing careers and industries. But ideas alone do nothing without follow-through. Frank Elsner’s career shows how steady action, applied over time, can turn practical ideas into real results. Read more: Frank Elsner Builds Big Ideas Through Steady Action

item.title: How Digital Gaming Trends Are Reshaping Modern Entertainment Businesses
item.description: We explore how digital gaming—especially crypto-enabled formats—is influencing audience behavior, monetization, and engagement strategies for today’s entertainment-focused businesses. Read more: How Digital Gaming Trends Are Reshaping Modern Entertainment Businesses

item.title: Stop watching Netflix and go to the pub, Welsh first minister tells public
item.description: Welsh first minister Eluned Morgan has urged people to stop watching Netflix and go to the pub as Wales unveils a one-year business rates discount for hospitality. Read more: Stop watching Netflix and go to the pub, Welsh first minister tells public

item.title: EU has ‘open mind’ on UK customs union talks, commissioner says
item.description: Brussels is open to discussing closer trade ties with the UK, including a customs union, as EU commissioner Valdis Dombrovskis signals willingness to re-engage. Read more: EU has ‘open mind’ on UK customs union talks, commissioner says

item.title: Barclay brothers given six weeks to strike deal to avoid bankruptcy
item.description: Howard and Aidan Barclay have until 17 March to strike a deal with creditors after HSBC launched bankruptcy proceedings linked to the collapse of Yodel and ArrowXL owner Logistics Group. Read more: Barclay brothers given six weeks to strike deal to avoid bankruptcy

item.title: Women in tech and finance face higher risk of AI job losses, City of London report warns
item.description: Women working in technology and financial services are at greater risk of losing their jobs to artificial intelligence and automation than men, according to a new report from the City of London Corporation. Read more: Women in tech and finance face higher risk of AI job losses, City of London report warns

item.title: Santander attacks FCA ‘overreach’ as UK car finance scandal bill passes £460m
item.description: Santander has accused the FCA of regulatory overreach after setting aside £461m for the UK motor finance scandal, as its Spanish parent agrees a $12bn US bank takeover. Read more: Santander attacks FCA ‘overreach’ as UK car finance scandal bill passes £460m

item.title: Post Office to receive £104m taxpayer bailout to cover historic IR35 breach
item.description: The UK government will cover a £104m IR35 tax bill at Post Office Limited after historic off-payroll working failures left the public body unable to pay. Read more: Post Office to receive £104m taxpayer bailout to cover historic IR35 breach

item.title: Pinterest sacks engineers after internal tool exposed laid-off staff during AI-driven cuts
item.description: Pinterest has dismissed two engineers who created software to identify colleagues made redundant as the company cuts 15% of jobs and shifts further towards AI. Read more: Pinterest sacks engineers after internal tool exposed laid-off staff during AI-driven cuts

item.title: Peter Jones buys American Golf as Dragons’ Den star expands retail empire
item.description: Dragons’ Den investor Peter Jones has acquired American Golf, the UK’s largest golf retailer, as he looks to revive the loss-making chain and expand its online business. Read more: Peter Jones buys American Golf as Dragons’ Den star expands retail empire
